name: Stepperize
summary: Type-safe React toolkit for step-by-step workflows: stepper state, navigation and unstyled primitives.
description: A type-safe toolkit for building multi-step workflows in React, distributed as @stepperize/react and a framework-agnostic core package. Steps are plain objects with typed ids; hooks and a Provider manage local or shared state and step-scoped drafts, with flat navigation (next, prev, goTo, reset), per-step validation and typed rendering. The docs site adds 28 shadcn-ready stepper blocks (progress bar, segmented tabs, circular, breadcrumb, vertical, onboarding and booking flows) installable from a registry.
contains: @stepperize/react v8 package plus framework-agnostic core, MIT license
useStepper, useStepperContext, Provider: local or shared step state
flat navigation: id, current, index, next, prev, goTo, reset
typed rendering with match/is; step-scoped drafts and validation (Standard Schema)
28 shadcn-ready stepper blocks on stepperize.com/blocks, installable from the registry
